pointers.sentence: `_active` is an asgiref `Local` whose one attribute, value, holds a translation object, not a code: a lookup takes the object and asks it (`django/utils/translation/trans_real.py:_active`).

The `Local` keeps its value in a context variable, tagged with the thread that set it, and ignores a value tagged with another, so a thread starts with nothing active even where it inherits its starter's context (`asgiref:asgiref/local.py:_CVar._storage`).

`sync_to_async` and `async_to_sync` re-tag the value for the thread they run code in, so it reaches that code, and the value the code leaves comes back to the caller (`asgiref:asgiref/sync.py:_restore_context`).

`django.utils.translation.activate` ignores an empty code or `None`, and passes any other to `translation`, which makes the language's `DjangoTranslation` or gives back the one it made before ([Message catalogues: `DjangoTranslation`](catalogues.md)) (`django/utils/translation/trans_real.py:activate`).

`deactivate_all` installs the standard library's `gettext.NullTranslations`, which gives back every message as it was asked for, its to_language made to return `None` (`django/utils/translation/trans_real.py:deactivate_all`).

Its docstring gives the use: lazy translations then appear as the original string, which is how `Options.verbose_name_raw` gives a model's name untranslated, through `override(None)` (`django/db/models/options.py:Options.verbose_name_raw`).
With nothing active it returns `LANGUAGE_CODE`, without making a translation (`django/utils/translation/trans_real.py:get_language`).
`get_language_bidi` gives `False` for `None`, and otherwise whether the code's part before its first hyphen is in `LANGUAGES_BIDI` (`django/utils/translation/trans_real.py:get_language_bidi`).
`django.utils.translation.override` exists only in the facade, built from its functions, so with `USE_I18N` false it does nothing either (`django/utils/translation/__init__.py:override`).

`{% language %}` overrides it for its body ([The libraries to load: static, i18n, l10n, tz and cache](../templates/loadable-libraries.md)), `translate_url` to reverse an address ([Language prefixes and translated routes](../urls/i18n.md)), and a sitemap with `Sitemap.i18n` for each item's location (`django/contrib/sitemaps/__init__.py:Sitemap._location`).

A test's `override_settings` of `LANGUAGE_CODE`, `LANGUAGES` or `LOCALE_PATHS` replaces the object that holds the language, emptying it for every thread ([Overriding settings](../startup/overrides.md)) (`django/test/signals.py:language_changed`).
`LocaleMiddleware.process_response` leaves the language active, and nothing else in Django deactivates it when a request ends (`django/middleware/locale.py:LocaleMiddleware.process_response`).
`django.conf.locale.LANG_INFO` gives, for each language code, the `"code"`, the English `"name"`, the `"name_local"` in the language itself, and `"bidi"` (`django/conf/locale/__init__.py`).
Otherwise it raises `KeyError`, as for `"xx"` or the locale name `"nl_BE"` (`django/utils/translation/__init__.py:get_language_info`).
